}} The '''Exclusive Card Pack''' is located in the [[Exclusive Shop (Pet Simulator 99)|Exclusive Shop]] in [[Pet Simulator 99]], adding during the [[Trading Cards Event 2025 (Pet Simulator 99)|Trading Cards Event 2025]]. Card packs can be purchased for 99 {{Robux}} each, or purchased in bundles of 30 for 2,699 {{Robux}}, with a bonus 50 Exclusive Raffle Tickets. Upon purchase, card packs are stored in the inventory, where they can be opened for 5 random cards included within the pack, or traded. Cards can be combined in the [[Card Combination Machine (Pet Simulator 99)|Card Combination Machine]] in the [[Super Computer (Pet Simulator 99)|Supercomputer]]. To ensure compliance with regulations concerning paid random items, cards cannot be purchased if the player is located in Australia, Belgium, Netherlands, South Korea, or the UK (if the user is under 18).
